_about: Hand-kept facts per place for the route finder. Keys: a room code (RTP-XF-05-10), a plan room id shown on an unnamed room's card as Map id (L2-p1003236572), entrance:1, or node:L1-n52 for a lift or stairs. Fields: name (labels an unnamed room or corrects a name), access (keycard | staff | closed), note (one short line shown with the place). Photos are not listed here: save photos/<key>.jpg and run make_shotlist.py; see photos/README.md and photos/SHOTLIST.md.
